rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a recipe, including both mixture instructions and cooking instructions.

example.english: This recipe is written clearly enough that even beginners can follow it.
example.traditional: 呢本食譜寫得好清楚，新手都跟到。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 sik6 pou2 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 san1 sau2 dou1 gan1 dou2
